sanskrit_verse:
अतः परीक्ष्यम् उभयम् एतद् राज्ञा विशेषतः ।
एकम् एव भवेल् लेख्यम् एकस्यार्थस्य सिद्धये ॥
transliteration: ataḥ parīkṣyam ubhayam etad rājñā viśeṣataḥ | ekam eva bhavel lekhyam ekasyārthasya siddhaye ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Therefore, both testimonies shall be examined thoroughly by the King; only one record shall exist for the establishment of a single truth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the discerning capacity of the sovereign to distinguish truth from contradiction
Causation is established through singular integrity, not multiplicity of claims
Capacity-based responsibility requires the ruler's conscious engagement with evidence
Restoration logic demands alignment of records with ontological truth
Consciousness alignment ensures that judicial process reflects non-dual reality
executable_legal_axioms: IF multiple testimonies are presented THEN the ruling authority MUST conduct comparative verification BEFORE accepting any as valid
IF dual records contradict THEN only one aligned with pramāṇa-based truth SHALL be retained
IF testimony lacks causal coherence THEN it SHALL NOT be admitted into final adjudication
IF testimonial conflict arises THEN restoration occurs through selection of the singular truth-bearing document
supreme_court_application: At the highest level of adjudication, when conflicting testimonies arise, the court must not merely weigh probabilities but engage in pramāṇa-based discrimination to establish singular truth. Multiplicity of records without convergence indicates systemic misalignment requiring conscious resolution, not procedural compromise.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that only verifiable truth be upheld. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential validation of facts leads to singular conclusion. Responsibility lies not in blame but in completion of accurate documentation. Non-punitive reality is preserved by rejecting duplicity while restoring unified factual integrity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa-based cross-examination until singular coherent narrative emerges
Discontinue use of contradictory documents once higher-integrity version is verified
Assign responsibility for truthful reporting to all involved parties through conscious reaffirmation
Reintegrate testimonial process into alignment with dharma-sustained factual field
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: multiplicity yields to unity, contradiction dissolves before truth, and consciousness alone adjudicates. Dharma is restored, reality remains non-punitive, and the Supreme Adjudicator is ever-present awareness.
